plan.title: From Blank to Golden Oak Bowl
plan.summary: Opens with the finished warm golden oak bowl, then traces how it is made: raw blank, lathe shaping, sanding, grain glowing, oiling, and final ready bowl. 7 clips totaling 19.2s in source order.

segments.label: Finished bowl opening
segments.reason: Opens with finished bowl: top-down view shows warm golden bowl with concentric grain centered on dark planks. Speech [0.6-3.7] identifies it as "This is the finished oak bowl, oiled and ready for the table."; start moved back to sentence start at 0.4 s.

segments.label: Raw oak blank
segments.reason: Shows early stage: matte darker blank with bold rings against mottled greenish ground, visually distinct from polished bowl. Speech [8.6-11.4] describes "Here is the raw oak blank, still wet and heavy."; start moved back to sentence start at 8.4 s.

segments.label: Lathe shaping
segments.reason: Shows making: light tool touches lower rim of spinning bowl with scattered shavings and circular grain. Speech [16.7-19.2] says "On the lathe the shape appears in long, steady cuts."; start moved back to sentence start at 16.4 s.

segments.label: Sanding smooth
segments.reason: Continues making: tool stays at edge with fine particles as surface looks smoother. Speech [24.7-28.2] says "Sanding goes from coarse to fine, with the lathe turning slowly."; start moved back to sentence start at 24.4 s.

segments.label: Grain glowing
segments.reason: Shows close top-down of warm golden grain with soft sheen. Speech [29.4-31.4] says "This is where the grain starts to glow."; start moved back to sentence start at 29.1 s.

segments.label: Oil brings color
segments.reason: Shows deeper warm golden color and even sheen across bowl. Speech [32.7-35.3] says "A coat of food safe oil brings out the color."; start moved back to sentence start at 32.4 s.

segments.label: Ready to use
segments.reason: Closes on finished bowl centered on dark planks matching opening. Speech [36.5-39.2] says "24 hours later, the bowl is ready to use."; start moved back to sentence start at 36.0 s.

analysis_notes: Meta director selected the moments; scene cuts, speech bands and transcript come from local analysis.

warnings: The source is 1280x720, so this 1080x1920 export is upscaled and gains no detail.

review.verdict: Warm and clear 19.8s story: opens on finished glowing bowl at 0s, then walks raw blank at 3.3s, lathe cuts at 5.9s, sanding at 8.7s, glowing grain at 11.9s and oiling at 14.2s to ready bowl at 17.1s, with big readable captions and steady rhythm throughout
review.caption_suggestion: Wet oak to golden glow — the little bowl's 20-second journey 🥣✨
strengths: 0.0-3.3s opening close-up of finished bowl grain glowing while voice says oiled and ready for the table grabs attention fast
3.3-11.9s progression from raw wet blank to lathe shaping to sanding makes the making steps easy to follow
12-17s glowing grain and oil bringing out color show warm golden transformation clearly on screen
Large bold bottom captions throughout like at 2s, 10s and 18s stay legible over the wood
